description: Canonical, self-contained verification fixture set for the DSAF maximal-audit engine. These DESIGN.md files are vendored (committed) so `npm run verify` is hermetic and offline-deterministic: it does not depend on network access, git clones, or machine-specific paths. The generator (scripts/bin/build-verification-cases.mjs) runs the engine on each case; the check (scripts/checks/check-maximal-cases.mjs) validates the produced outputs. Source corpus: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md (vendored snapshot).
